name: Dimetric
description: Two of the three axes foreshortened equally, which is what dimetric means.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: skewY(-20deg) scaleX(1.1); transform: skewY(-20deg) scaleX(1.1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x % 2 == 1) { :after { -webkit-transform: skewY(20deg) scaleX(1.1); transform: skewY(20deg) scaleX(1.1); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
